basis: renders a bare <div> — pure geometry from the layout engine, no semantics of its own.

responsive.basis: the column is capped by maxWidth (mx-auto) and never driven wider; the gutter steps 16→24→32 px at the law's sm and wide bands, and the conformance route holds the rendered gutter to CENTER_GUTTER_STEPS at all three bands.

harness.because: layout-conformance proves the engine twin against the mounted DOM — geometry evidence beyond the none row, kept because it is how the composition's layout is proven

interaction.basis: a pure centering wrapper — nothing operates, nothing focuses.

exceptions.because: no inertness pin yet — nothing in it operates or takes focus by design, and the browserless tier does not yet prove the absence
